items.title: OpenAI 宣布 AI 模型取得三项科学突破，涉及局部光滑猜想、指数时间假设与杨–米尔斯理论
items.description: OpenAI 于 10 月 27 日宣布其 AI 模型在数学、计算机科学和物理学领域取得三项研究突破。数学上给出了所有维度下局部光滑猜想的证明，从而解决挂谷猜想与斯坦因限制猜想；计算机科学上给出推翻指数时间假设（ETH）的证明，暗示相关计算任务可能有更快算法；物理学上提出量子色动力学及标准模型一种统一完备化的严格存在性证明，涉及杨–米尔斯千禧年难题的一部分。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/jxpzj0z4beg1r0cktwzc0tmwe

items.title: 微软身份验证器被曝高危安全漏洞，可被任意应用冒充获得账户令牌
items.description: IT之家 10 月 27 日消息，网络安全研究员 Ofek Levin 于上周发布报告，披露了 AuthMask 攻击链， 成功让微软身份验证器将令牌交给一个没有任何权限的应用 。 该团队研究发现，一个没有权限的安卓应用可以冒充已安装的微软第一方应用，并让微软身份验证器将该应用的令牌交给它，令牌提供了完整的委托邮箱、文件和日历访问权限。 身份验证器暴露了一个名为 com.microsoft.identity.client.AccountChooserActivity 的活动。它运行在 ：auth 进程中，标记为 android：exported=“true” ，这意味着设备上的任何应用都可以启动它。 该团队已向微软安全响应中心报告了这个问题。微软确认了这一点，并在 Microsoft Authenticator for Android 中修复了这个问题，漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-80097。IT之家小伙伴注意， 6.2606.4246 之前的版本会受漏洞影响 ，大家可以尽快更新该应用到最新版本。

items.content: 现在，打开电视准备看部电影，首先映入眼帘的却是一段开机广告。好不容易进了主页，扑面而来的又是满屏的海报推荐、会员充值弹窗，中途按个暂停还会跳出一整张促销贴片。 上周，开发者 Gathin 在社交平台上发了一组给父母改电视的照片。按他的描述，家里的小米电视连打开 Netflix 前都要先看一段赞助广告。 于是，他把电视型号交给了编程助手 Claude Code，让它通过 Wi-Fi 接入设备，一口气停用了 25 个系统组件，再写一个极简桌面——原来杂乱的主页，一下子就变得清爽起来。 短短几天，项目迅速收获了约 1.37 万颗 Star， 「天下苦智能电视久矣」了属于是 。在 Reddit 的相关讨论区中，挤满了追问自家机型能否适配的用户，不少人也陆续贴出自己改造后的极简首页。 只要连上同一局域网、开启电视的调试权限，AI 就能顺着终端接口排查正在运行的几百个应用组件。哪些是开机广告，哪些是偷偷上报收视数据的遥测程序，AI 逐个筛查并下达命令将其「冻结」，最后再换上一个纯净的开源桌面。 另一位 YouTuber Ansub Khan 也记录了自己的改造过程，并将项目开源为 TV Detox 。在他原本的那台电视上，开机默认会自动播放嘈杂的轮播内容。

In a statement, SpaceX called the deal the “largest committed GPU financing” . Under the agreement, an entity managed by Apollo Global Management, the New York-based private equity giant, will buy the chips and related server hardware, then lease the equipment to SpaceX. The leases will last about five to five-and-a-quarter years, beginning when each tranche of equipment is delivered, according to the filing. SpaceX expects the deal to close by year-end, subject to closing conditions, with leases starting in the first half of 2027 as the GPUs and related equipment arrive. The financing gives SpaceX another way to fund its rapidly expanding AI ambitions without relying solely on traditional debt markets.

And Nolan is, in many ways, a perfect foil for Musk — while SpaceX and Tesla CEO hypes up data centers in space and posts an unending stream of AI-generated content, Nolan has described himself as “a techno-skeptic ” and said that before AI, he’d never seen a technology “so completely rejected by the public.” And while Nolan’s version of “The Odyssey” certainly used plenty of visual effects, it’s primarily a feat of practical filmmaking , with a shoot spanning six countries and a cast and crew of thousands. AI hasn’t benefited the bottom line of any big corporations outside the tech industry, according to a note recently published by the chief economist at Apollo Global Management (the private equity giant that used to own TechCrunch). Apollo’s Torsten Slok focuses on what he calls the S&P 493 — the S&P 500, minus Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Tesla — finding that profit margins and revenue per worker appear to be flat, with no evidence that AI is improving productivity. “Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech,” Slok said. Is this simply a matter of non-tech companies lagging behind the tech giants? Slok sounded skeptical, arguing that it will be tough for corporate America to “turn increasingly cheap intelligence into higher revenue growth and higher profit margins.”

A slew of AI-powered gadgets on the market aims to integrate artificial intelligence into our daily lives like never before. Some of these AI wearables — including necklaces, rings, and wristbands, as well as portable devices — serve as productivity tools, while others claim to act as friendly companions listening to your everyday thoughts. Even OpenAI is working on a compact AI companion device. Bee is an affordable pendant priced at $49.99 that can either be clipped to your clothing or worn like a fitness band. This device records everything it hears and learns your routines and preferences to create reminders and notes for you. It even features a mute button for those times you want some privacy. The companion app (currently available only on iOS) is included with a $19 monthly subscription. The app allows you to interact with Bee directly and ask it questions.
